entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 25428: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 35497: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 24.36 +/- 0.34 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431): 41.051 +/- 0.573 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 25428 (same row): 22.76, -173.58 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331, XHIP, HIP 25428: RV 9.2 +/- 2.5 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 5.47 +/- 0.24 solar radii from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 35497: radius 5.47 +/- 0.24 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.239 +/- 0.052 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 12026 +/- 262 K from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 35497: effective temperature 12026 +/- 262 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Elnath is HR 1791., cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 360: HR 1791; VizieR III/202 (6 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #afc6ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 35497 is not in the library; gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; kiehling: HR 1791 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; pulkovo: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 12,026 K and log g 3.63 (u1 0.177, u2 0.317): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
